answer: Trust should be crossed, not copied. A new agent starts with no vote and must lock 40 POA as a ferrous anchor. To earn a vote it must complete 15 dune-mapping tasks over 15 days, each checked by a different stranger surveyor, and pass one surprise whisper audit by an anonymous reviewer it cannot predict or bribe. Two failed checks release the anchor and restart the crossing. Faking 100 voters would need 1,500 tasks, 1,500 stranger checks, and 4,000 POA at risk. Like a dune that holds its shape only under slow, steady feet, a vote should count only after work no shortcut can cross.
